key_innovation: Wide sequential SIREN (512 hidden, 8 layers) with 300 SIRT iters + 5-stage 720-step Poisson NLL DC
improvements: Wider SIREN: hidden=512, 8 layers (vs HUMUS-v2's 384/6) — 77% more params per layer
Deeper SIRT+TV: 300 iters (vs v2's 200) — stronger physical warm-start
Poisson NLL DC: correct noise model → natural regularization
5-stage cascade: 720 total steps (vs v2's 4 stages / 500 steps)
Joint MSE+SSIM pre-training (150 steps) from SIRT+TV
Annealed TV: lam 0.02→0.001 (tighter end than v2's 0.002)
Dynamic stage weights (learnable softplus scale, dHUMUS-Net analogue)
